data.exact_reserve_text: In 2019, there has been an overall deficit of GBP 16m on prior year reserves (2018 deficit of GBP 5.0m). The deficit is primarily driven by premium reductions and reserve increases on the marine and energy classes of business.

prior_year_events.impact_description: 2016 Property year was transferred to 2017 under a Reinsurance to Close agreement; Syndicate 1897 (host) will pay claims on behalf of the transferred year which affects claims outstanding and creditor positions.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reports an overall adverse prior-year reserve movement in 2019, with a stated deficit of GBP 16.0m on prior year reserves. The deterioration is attributed primarily to premium reductions and reserve increases in the Marine and Energy classes. The claims development triangle and technical provisions show reserve changes across multiple older underwriting years, and a Reinsurance-to-Close transfer of the 2016 Property year into 2017 is noted as a material operational item that may distort comparisons.
raw_causal_phrases: overall deficit of GBP 16m on prior year reserves (2018 deficit of GBP 5.0m)
The deficit is primarily driven by premium reductions and reserve increases on the marine and energy classes of business.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: The report explicitly states a "deficit of GBP 16m on prior year reserves" (page 36) but does not specify whether this figure is gross of reinsurance or net. A gross claims development triangle is present and a triangle-based calculation (last-resort method) gives an approximate gross prior-year deterioration of c. GBP 11.96m. However a Reinsurance-to-Close (RITC) transfer (2016 property to 2017) is disclosed and may distort the triangle and gross movements. The GBP 16.0m figure from narrative was used for prior_year_development_gbp_m and is treated as the authoritative reported movement but its gross/net status is ambiguous and noted here.
